name: riah-todo
description: Today's list as a note by the Windows clock. Click the tray icon, tick things off, click away. One JSON file, no server required.
//: private: this is a Windows app people download from GitHub, not an npm package. It stops an accidental `npm publish`; remove it only if we deliberately choose npm distribution.

scripts.//test: Quoted so NODE expands the glob. Unquoted it relies on the shell, and pwsh does not — which is why CI was red on every run while it passed locally.
scripts.check: npm test && npm run smoke:race && npm run smoke:server && npm run smoke:guard && npm run smoke:note
scripts.check:ci: npm test && npm run smoke:race && npm run smoke:server
